status_note: Proposed values for team review. Nothing here is frozen until all three members approve each decision below. No 2018-2019 data has been read or scored.

comparator.rule: Stronger standalone personalized model by mean 2017 validation NDCG@10 (P1.6; exact tie -> Item-CF).

hybrid_item_cf_weight.rule: Highest mean 2017 validation NDCG@10 among interior weights 0.1-0.9 at full precision; exact ties go to the weight closest to 0.5, then to the smaller weight. w=0 (MF) and w=1 (Item-CF) are references and cannot be selected.

notes.matrix_factorization.monitor_clip_min/mo: Fitting setting only: clips the training RMSE used by MF's tolerance stop. Not applied to predictions, ranking or the hybrid, and not the hybrid clipping rule.

proposal.alignment: both components scored on the same ordered original userId/movieId arrays
proposal.missing_scores: missing or non-finite component scores filled with the shared fallback bias model (settings above) before blending; counts recorded per component
proposal.blend: hybrid = w * item_cf + (1 - w) * mf on the raw, unclipped component scores
proposal.ranking: blended scores ranked without clipping; movies the user rated before the recommendation date excluded after blending (cohort.rank_top_k); exact ties broken by ascending movieId; 10 movies returned
proposal.rating_metrics: for RMSE/MAE, blend the raw scores first, then clip the resulting rating prediction once to [0.5, 5]

protocol_amendment.original_wording: Use full-precision predictions on the original rating scale and apply any clipping consistently before the blend.
protocol_amendment.note: Protocol changes require approval by all three members; approving this decision includes approving A1.

practical_margin.status_note: Provisional P1.6 value presented for review. Must not be revised merely to clear the observed validation gain; record keep/revise and reasons.

runtime_evidence_provisional.fallback_fit_note: lambda=10 fallback fit not timed separately
runtime_evidence_provisional.p32_sweep_note: Cache-based evaluation of all eleven weights; no fitting or scoring. Not a single hybrid's end-to-end runtime.
runtime_evidence_provisional.configured_hybrid_note: Not yet measured; required in the final evaluation.

proposal.method: paired user-level bootstrap on the final-test cohort
proposal.resample_size: number of evaluated test users, with replacement
proposal.proposed_implementation: numpy.random.default_rng(42); resample user indices; numpy.percentile default (linear) interpolation

uncertainty.decision_table: P1.6 'Paired uncertainty and decision rule' (strict comparisons)

proposal.refit_models: Item-CF, MF and fallback with the frozen settings and seeds; no retuning
proposal.less_popular_classification: fixed top 3,593 by pre-2017 count (ties by movieId)
proposal.user_eligibility: at least one pre-2017 rating (frozen P1.2 rule)
proposal.positives: 2018-2019 ratings > 3 on catalogue movies not rated before 2018-01-01
proposal.evaluated_users: eligible users with at least one test positive
proposal.exclusions: all movies the user rated before 2018-01-01
proposal.popularity_reference: recount on pre-2018 ratings; reported separately
proposal.report: all three NDCG@10 means (hybrid, MF, Item-CF), paired difference and interval; Recall@10, coverage, less-popular exposure
proposal.runtime_required: Measure and report the configured hybrid's full runtime, from fitting Item-CF, MF and the fallback through scoring, blending and top-10 generation, under the same conditions as MF alone; report the amortized sweep cost separately (P1.6).
proposal.not_yet_implemented: test positives file and final-test runner (P3.9)

phase_gates.proposal: Record P1.9 and P2.9 approvals before final-test scoring
